title: UL-20 — Challenge: Terraform workflow modules state import
scenario: Refactor fixture into a module, import an bucket, produce saved plan without applying it.
acceptanceCriteria: Root module calls a child module for the S3 bucket resource.
terraform init succeeds with local backend.
Existing bucket imported via terraform import into module address.
terraform plan saved to file plan.out not applied.
Saved plan shows expected changes only.
Manual destroy or terraform destroy removes bucket after any apply you chose.
No remote backend with credentials in git.
Plan file deleted from git status.
Tag search LabId=ul-20 empty after destroy.

hints.text: Do not commit plan or state.

stopChargesPanel: Destroy any applied resources; remove state for ul-20.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Uses: $Suffix, $Bucket (the values you set while building; unset ones are skipped)
# Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-20
# Run the next line from your UL-20 root module folder, not from lab-fixtures/gl-20.
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-20 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION

aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-20 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION (only relevant if you imported the GL-20 bucket into this lab's state)
aws s3api head-bucket --bucket $Bucket returns 404 (only set if you created or imported a bucket for this lab)
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-20 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-20. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-20) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
